summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Nonton Bareng MBI ticketing app. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases passing (event, seats Cara-B locking, order create with unique code, locked-session 400, double-book 409, locked-seat 400, proof upload, admin login/protected, verify/reject/checkin, reject-frees-seat, set-active-session, stats). Frontend: booking flow (name+phone -> session -> seats A3/A4 -> QRIS -> confirm dialog -> submit) works, order status page with unique-coded total (Rp 100.091), reminder dialog, countdown (14:58), QRIS image, transfer tab, file upload sets status Menunggu Verifikasi and shows proof preview. Admin login rejects wrong pw, admin dashboard shows stats, session control, filter tabs, orders table, view-proof dialog, verify/reject/print buttons. One real bug found in upload-proof response payload.

minor.issue: Response does not include the `session` and `transfer` fields that GET /api/orders/{id} attaches. Frontend replaces its order state with this response, causing session/transfer info to disappear in UI after upload. Fix: attach session + TRANSFER_INFO before returning (mirror get_order).

ui_bugs.issue: After uploading proof, Detail Pesanan 'Sesi' shows just ' · ' and Transfer tab shows empty Bank / No. Rekening / Atas Nama because the response used to update state lacks session+transfer keys.

integration_issues.issue: State returned from proof-upload endpoint is missing session/transfer info causing display gaps until user reloads.

action_items: Fix POST /api/orders/{id}/proof to return the order with `session` and `transfer` populated (same logic as GET /api/orders/{id}), OR in frontend re-fetch GET /api/orders/{id} after upload instead of replacing state with the POST response.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: upload_proof returns clean(o) without session/transfer attachment (line 302). get_order (line 285) does attach them. This inconsistency is the root cause of the observed UI gap.
server.py: taken_seats/gen_unique_total iterate all orders — fine at MVP scale but should be indexed on (session_id, status) for larger loads.
server.py: admin token is a static string in env; acceptable for MVP but should be rotatable/expirable in future.

OrderStatusPage.js line 147: renders `order.session?.name · order.session?.time` — protects against undefined but produces the ugly ' · ' string when session missing. Consider hiding the row entirely if session absent.
seed_data_creation: Test orders created via API during pytest run (TEST_ prefixed) and via UI flow (TEST_UI_User with seats A3,A4). Not cleaned to preserve data for main-agent verification; can be removed by dropping db.orders.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. If retesting after fix, verify: (1) POST /api/orders/{id}/proof response now contains keys 'session' and 'transfer'; (2) After uploading proof in UI, Detail Pesanan shows Sesi 1 · 13:00 WIB and Transfer tab shows BCA + 061 518 3381 + PD Majelis Buddhayana Indonesia Prov Kepri without page reload. Booking flow creates real orders in db.orders; seat A1..A4 already occupied in session 1 by previous tests.
rca of the issue: Root cause: In backend/server.py upload_proof endpoint (~line 288-302) the response payload only calls clean(o), whereas GET /api/orders/{id} appends `session` (looked up from SESSIONS) and `transfer` (TRANSFER_INFO). Frontend OrderStatusPage.handleFile does setOrder(data) with this response, so the previously-populated session/transfer fields get overwritten with undefined. Reproduction: 1) Book any order, 2) Upload proof, 3) Observe Sesi and Transfer tab fields go blank. Mitigation: attach session+transfer in upload_proof response OR re-fetch GET /api/orders/{id} after upload.
